name: tmux
description: A pane listing the interactive Claude Code and Codex sessions in the current tmux session, showing each one's state (Active, Needs you, Idle) and highlighting the one facing the user; click one to bring it to the front, its [x] twice to close it, or a [new] to start another Claude Code or Codex session.

new_session_command.title: New session command
new_session_command.description: The command line the Claude Code [new] row types into the new tmux window's shell

new_codex_command.title: New Codex session command
new_codex_command.description: The command line the Codex [new] row types into the new tmux window's shell

codex_roster_command.title: Codex window list command
codex_roster_command.description: The command a Codex window brought to the front or started by [new] runs in a pane beside Codex to show this list, such as tmux-roster; empty for none
